AMOS tutorial. Compilation does not guarantee completed execution; the Debug menu reports runtime limits. Select Keyboard: Typing for text prompts. Hold the right mouse button to open AMOS menus, point to an item, then release to select.

Tutorials/AMAL/AMAL_3.AMOS

Controls

Follow the game's intro and menu prompts. Arrows move; Space/Enter fires. Choose Keyboard: Typing to enter text; switch back to Keyboard: Joystick to play. Gamepad and touch controls work in both modes. Escape leaves fullscreen.
